meta.name: cold-email
meta.description: Write B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences that get replies. Use when the user wants to write cold outreach emails, prospecting emails, cold email campaigns, sales development emails, or SDR emails. Also use when the user mentions "cold outreach," "prospecting email," "outbound email," "email to leads," "reach out to prospects," "sales email," "follow-up email sequence," "nobody's replying to my emails," or "how do I write a cold email." Covers subject lines, opening lines, body copy, CTAs, personalization, and multi-touch follow-up sequences. For warm/lifecycle email sequences, see emails. For sales collateral beyond emails, see sales-enablement.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出高回复率的B2B冷邮件和跟进序列
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要向潜在客户发送冷邮件并提高回复率。
copy.tagline_en: Write B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences that get replies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send cold outreach emails to prospects and get more replies.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你写 B2B 冷邮件和跟进序列，包括主题行、开头、正文、行动号召、个性化内容以及多轮跟进。它会像一位聪明的同事一样写作，避免模板化语言，确保每封邮件都像真人写的。
howto.when: 当你想写冷邮件、开发信、销售邮件或跟进序列时触发。也适用于你说“冷 outreach”、“prospecting email”、“outbound email”等关键词时。

say.text: 帮我写一封给某公司CTO的冷邮件，目标是约个15分钟电话。
为我的SaaS产品写一个3封邮件的跟进序列。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含不同角度和间隔的跟进序列。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you write B2B cold emails and follow-up sequences, covering subject lines, opening lines, body copy, CTAs, personalization, and multi-touch follow-ups. It writes like a sharp human, avoiding template language and ensuring every sentence earns its place.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to write cold outreach emails, prospecting emails, sales development emails, or follow-up sequences. Also triggered by keywords like "cold outreach," "prospecting email," "outbound email," etc.

say_en.text: Write a cold email to a CTO at a target company, aiming for a 15-minute call.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for role, company, value prop, etc., then generate the email.

say_en.text: Create a 3-email follow-up sequence for my SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a sequence with different angles and increasing gaps.
